name: Obito's Mangekyo Sharingan Right
description: (Tag:illusion)(Tag:mental)(Tag:movement)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)(Tag:space)You possess Obito Uchiha's right eye, granting half of Kamui plus full Sharingan benefits such as incredible visual prowess and instant memorization. With the left eye, you access a short-range Kamui to an endless pocket dimension in your left eye. You can fully enter Kamui to reposition in the real world, semi-enter to turn intangible at stamina cost, or send touched objects into Kamui.
